RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Tuesday,  the March 6, 2007/Phalguna 15, 1928 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Civil Aviation; Company Affairs; Culture; Finance;
Heavy Industries and Public Enterprises; Petroleum and
Natural Gas; Tourism; Water Resources)
Total number of questions — 20
Domestic LPG connections
*101. SHRI THENNALA G.
BALAKRISHNA PILLAI: Will the
Minister of PETROLEUM AND
NATURAL GAS be pleased to state:
(a) whether the State Government of
Kerala had made any request for the
increase of LPG domestic connection quota
to the State;
(b) if so, the action that has been taken
in this regard;
(c) whether it is a fact that the oil
companies are not sanctioning second
cylinder in Kerala;
(d) if so, the reasons therefor; and
(e) the total number of waiting list for
LPG domestic connections in the country
up to the 31st of December, 2006, State-
wise?
APSAL-III for Andhra Pradesh
*102. SHRI NANDI YELLAIAH: Will
the Minister of FINANCE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether the State Government of
Andhra Pradesh has requested the Central
Government to recommend APSAL-III,
involving cost of Rs. 1610 crores to the
World Bank and also to reconsider the
decision of direct foreign investment
participation in APSAL programme;
(b) if so, the details in this regard;
(c) the details of the guidelines, if any,
framed by the Ministry for considering
Structural Adjustment Loan applications,
beyond the 2nd SAL; and
(d) by when the above said request of
the State Government of Andhra Pradesh
is likely to be forwarded to the World Bank?
Financing of PSUs by JBIC
*103. SHRI M.V. MYSURA REDDY:
Will the Minister of FINANCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether the Japan Bank for
International Cooperation (JBIC) is financing
the Public Sector Undertakings in the
country;
(b) if so, the details of such undertakings/
corporations etc. indicating the total amount
of investment to be made therein, PSU-wise;
(c) whether any policy in this regard has
been formulated by Government; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?

35
Rate of Consumer Price Index
†*104. DR. MURLI MANOHAR
JOSHI:
SHRI RAM JETHMALANI:
Will the Minister of FINANCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have taken
notice of the rate of Consumer Price Index
(CPI) as reflected in the December, 2006
report on agriculture and rural labourers of
the country published by the Ministry of
Labour;
(b) if so, whether it is a fact that the
Index rate is 8.94 per cent and 8.31 per
cent respectively;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) the reasons for the rate being so high?
Development of potential tourism
spots in Jharkhand
*105. SHRI KAMAL AKHTAR: Will
the Minister of TOURISM be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government have identified
potential tourism spots in Jharkhand;
(b) if so, whether Government have any
plans to develop potential tourism areas; and
(c) if so, what are the identified areas
and proposed plans to develop tourist places?
Air borne collisions in crowded skies
*106. SHRI DEVDAS APTE:
SHRI SHATRUGHAN SINHA:
Will the Minister of CIVIL  AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
near misses between aeroplanes in the
crowded skies have increased three-fold in
the last five years;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the steps Government have taken
so far to avoid airborne collision; and
(d) the steps Government will take to
avoid any such incident arising due to the
fatigue of Airtraffic Controllers and pilots?
Suicide by the farmers
†*107. DR. PRABHA THAKUR: Will
the Minister of FINANCE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether the main reason of
committing suicide by the farmers in the
country is the incapacity of repaying the
debts;
(b) whether Government propose to write
off the interest on loans taken by the affected
farmers from banks in case of failure of
crops due to famine or any other reasons in
the particular area in order to save needy
and indebted farmers from misery and also
from committing suicide; and
(c) if so, the details thereof and if not,
the reasons therefor?
Completion of projects with Iran
†*108. SHRI SATYAVRAT
CHATURVEDI:
SHRI MOTILAL VORA:
Will the Minister of PETROLEUM
AND NATURAL GAS be pleased to
state:
(a) the quantum of gas (LNG) for which
India has made a deal to procure from Iran
and the duration for which the deal will be
valid;
(b) the price at which gas is being bought
by India and at what rate China is buying
gas from Iran;
(c) by when the work of laying a pipeline
from Iran to India via Pakistan is expected

take; and
(d) the steps being taken by Government
for expediting execution of gas-pipeline
laying work?
Increase in irrigation facilities in
Vidarbha region

the Minister of WATER RESOURCES be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the
arrangement of

Airport at Navi Mumbai
712. SHRIMATI SUPRIYA SULE: Will
the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether work on the proposed
airport in Navi Mumbai has been started;
(b) if so, by when the airport is going to
be completed;
(c) whether all formalities relating to
land acquisition have been sorted out and
the Central Government's clearance has
been obtained; and
(d) the total period of the project and
the approximate amount to be incurred on
this project?
Revamping of DGCA
713. SHRI B.K. HARIPRASAD: Will
the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether, despite the boom in Indian
civil aviation sector, there has been no
commensurate efforts to strengthen the
DGCA set-up;
(b) whether the Kaw Committee
instituted in 2005 had called for
strengthening the manpower base of DGCA
in every department;
(c) whether Government feel that the
creation of an Airport Economic Regulatory
Authority is expected to lessen the burden
on DGCA's functions; and
(d) whether Government are examining
the working models of airport regulators in
the US and the European Union for
possible revamping of DGCA?
Female pilots
714. SHRI TARIQ ANWAR: Will the
Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the number
of female pilots are increasing day by day
in the aviation sector in India;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the future programmes of
Government for further increase in the
number of female pilots?

167
Congestion at airports
715. DR. K. MALAISAMY: Will the
Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be pleased
to state:
(a) the specific reasons for the sudden
spurt and phenomenal increase in the
number of air passengers resulting in almost
all major airports to be crowded and
congested and worse than bus-stands;
(b) whether this increase was expected;
(c) if so, why action in advance was not
taken;
(d) if not, why it could not be gauged;
and
(e) the crisis management now
envisaged to deal with the problem?
Development of airports in the North
Eastern Region
716. SHRI O.T. LEPCHA: Will the
Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government have
formulated any scheme for expansion,
development and promotion of airports and
infrastructure in the North Eastern Region
particularly in the State of Sikkim;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the details of National Action Plan
prepared by Government for
implementation of the said scheme;
(d) the details of expenditure likely to
be incurred by Government in NER, State-
wise; and
(e) the steps taken by Government in
this regard?
Leasing of land by AAI to private
companies
717. SHRI C. RAMACHANDRA-
IAH: Will the Minister of CIVIL
AVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Airports Authority of
India (AAI) has provided its land to some
private companies on lease for commercial
purposes on revenue-sharing basis;
(b) if so, the number of private
companies to whom the AAI had given its
land on lease till March 31, 2006;
(c) the revenue share received by AAI
from the private companies during each of
the last three years;
(d) the revenue share of AAI outstanding
as on March 31, 2006; and
(e) the steps taken by AAI to recover
the outstanding amount from the concerned
parties?
Installation of Explosive Trace
Detectors
718. SHRI EKANATH K. THAKUR:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Airports
Authority of India (AAI) will install 200
Explosive Trace Detectors (ETDs) at all
77 airports of the country within the next
six months;
(b) whether it is also a fact that the
authority will be installing dual mode ETDs;
and
(c) if so, the special features of dual
mode ETDs and the estimated cost of their
installation?

168
Open Sky Agreement with ASEAN
719. SHRIMATI N.P. DURGA: Will
the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) the reasons behind Government
signing an Open Sky Agreement (OSA)
with ASEAN countries;
(b) whether any assessment has been
made about the positive and negative
aspects of OSA with ASEAN countries;
and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
Air services in H.P.
720. SHRI HARISH RAWAT: Will the
Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be pleased
to state:
(a) whether there is a proposal under
Government's consideration to construct a
new airport in Una, Himachal Pradesh;
(b) if so, by when this scheme will be
completed;
(c) whether it is a fact that the operation
of air services to Kangra and Kullu has been
stopped by Indian and other airlines;
(d) if so, the reasons therefor; and
(e) by when the air services to this
backward State are likely to be resumed?
Air rage in domestic and
international flights
